name: Calendar
description: A versatile calendar component for displaying and selecting dates, with month and year navigation and selection capabilities.
usage: Use the `selectedDate` prop to control the highlighted date.
Provide an `onDateSelect` callback to handle date selection.
Month and year can be navigated using the built-in controls.
Supports full keyboard accessibility for navigation and selection.
design: The calendar uses a fixed width (320px) for consistent layout.
Month/year selectors appear within the calendar container to avoid UI jumps.
Visual distinction between current month dates and dates from adjacent months.
Accommodates internationalization by using numeric representations for internally tracked dates.
Uses design system tokens for colors, borders, and interactive states.
accessibility: Full keyboard navigation: Tab, arrow keys, Enter, and Escape are supported.
Selected and today's dates are visually distinct.

props.name: selectedDate
props.description: Date that should be selected/highlighted in the calendar.

props.name: onDateSelect
props.description: Function called when a date is selected.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the calendar container.
